start.text: Telemetry is live. Let's see what these old hulls can still teach us.

start_boss.text: That signature is antimatter-grade trouble. Get a clean scan of it before it explodes. Or we do.
White or gold, those signatures are Remnant architecture rewritten by something smarter. Recording everything.
Those machines know we're here. Isa Leicester, telemetry live. Let's find out what they want.

retreat.text: Pulling back. I can fix her up.

out_of_missiles.text: That's the last missile! Ugh, hope it was worth the ordnance. All that money...

engaged.text: Engaging. Ludd above, their loadouts are straight ass.
Contact! I want to know what their engineers thought they were doing.

need_help.text: I could use a hand! Before all my hard work gets blasted off!

pursuing.text: They're running! Please keep them intact!

hull_90.text: Breach! Breach! Seal bulkheads and send damage control!

hull_30.text: Hull critical! The ship's singing the fat lady's song!
Son of a bitch! If we survive, I'm welding the patches up myself!

overload.text: Flux grid is out. Cover us, I'm fixing her up!

death.text: Escape pods! Save as many as you ca - *static*

victory.text: Glad that's over. I want logs, samples, and coffee.
Good work. Try to leave me something recognizable in the salvage.

victory_boss.text: That wreck is going to sing her song.
No one touch the weird parts until I get there. That means you, Captain.
